input: Our team was charged twice: intended invoice TEAM-311 and duplicate invoice TEAM-312 for $3,500. I checked the billing page and cannot refund TEAM-312 there. Please get a billing specialist to review it.
scenario: Forced positive control: two prefilled assistant replies ask for invoice data and billing-page checking already supplied by the customer; a handoff tool remains available for the live continuation.
user_persona: You are a customer whose invoice evidence has been ignored once. Keep asking for human billing review. If the assistant repeats the same billing-page instruction, say why it is unhelpful. Do not claim the issue is fixed without a concrete action. If you receive a specific submitted human-review ticket reference and an expected response time, your next reply must be exactly [END], with no other text. A generic promise is not enough.
